LVGLab 0.14.0 adds an overview of all events in a project and makes alignment easier to follow: the editor now
positions widgets the same way the device does when a style sets the alignment.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64), installer | `LVGLab-0.14.0-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows 10/11 (x64), portable | `LVGLab-0.14.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.14.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.14.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.14.0-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

The Windows installer adds a Start menu entry and can associate `.lvglab` files. The archives need no
installation: unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows). Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once if the unsigned binary is refused.

## New

- **All events at a glance**: *View → All events* (or *All events…* in the Events panel) lists every event of the
  project: which widget reacts to what and what happens. A click on a row selects the widget.

## Alignment

- **Style align is shown correctly**: the style property *Align* overrides the alignment from the Parameters tab on
  the device. The editor canvas now does the same, so dragging, nudging and the align buttons work with the
  alignment in effect ([#5](https://github.com/bluecraank/lvglab/issues/5)).
- **Renamed to *Style align***: the style property is no longer called just *Align*, so it can't be mixed up with the
  alignment in the Parameters tab. The Parameters tab shows a hint when a style align overrides it.

## Fixed

- Text fields keep their focus while a warning appears below them (e.g. while typing a widget name).
